9c0cd27513.q: Is rainmaking a skill that can be developed or an innate personality trait?
9c0cd27513.a: Business development is a skill like any other—it's not one of those things where you either have it or you don't. Almost anybody can develop a book of business if she's made up her mind that that's what she's going to do. Rainmakers demonstrate stick-to-itiveness, intentionality, focus, and deep knowledge of their ideal clients, returning to this effort repeatedly over time rather than expecting immediate results.

bfeead2145.q: How can introvert lawyers develop business and build a book of business?
bfeead2145.a: Introverts can approach business development through one-on-one meetings rather than large events, writing articles or blog posts, becoming connectors who introduce people in their network to each other, or attending conferences strategically by setting limited goals like having three conversations per day and leaving early to recharge. Introverts' strength as listeners and their ability to develop deep, genuine relationships with clients are significant advantages in business development.
